name: 24x26 Vertical Roof Metal Garage
description: The 24x26 vertical style metal garage comes standard with 9' legs fully enclosed. The cost of the garage door, walk in door or window is not included in the price. Select the garage door size that works best for you and the price with the garage door will automatically be updated in the price with options. Other options such as walk in door, window and taller side height can be added for an additional cost. The steel garage shown here include free delivery and installation in Alabama AL, Arkansas AR, Georgia GA, Illinois IL, Kansas KS, Kentucky KY, Louisiana LA, Mississippi MS, Missouri MO, North Carolina NC, Oklahoma OK, South Carolina SC, Tennessee TN, Texas TX, Virginia VA and West Virginia WV. Delivery area may not be available in all locations. *The metal garages are subject to change without notice Upon ordering the metal building at Alan's Factory Outlet a 10% to 17% deposit is due with either credit card or you can mail a check for the deposit with balance due once the steel garage is delivered and installed and final payment can be given via credit card or check for the remaining balance. Once you order you will be contacted and copy of the order will be emailed to you for you to review and approve to make sure everything is just like you want it. We anchor the metal buildings to the ground or asphalt for free with rebar and to the cement for free with concrete anchor bolts. The location for the building must be level or within at least 3" level or less or we will not be able to install it. If it is anchored to the ground you can upgrade with mobile home anchors. This is how the metal garage doors come standard on the gable end The steel garages with 9' legs going on concrete come certified for 140 mph and 30 psf. Certified metal garages come with blue print drawings which are rated for 140 mph wind rating and 30 psf snow load. name: Duramax Building Products 12 x 20 ft. Imperial Metal Garage, White
description: The popular 12X20 Metal Garage with Roll Up Door by DuraMax is now in off white. It is constructed of durable galvanized steel and features a reinforced roof support truss system that can hold a snow load of 20 pounds per square foot. One of the top sellers at Shed Nation, the metal garage is a tremendous value at this size. They are perfect for large vehicles, residential storage, commercial storage, or even a workshop studio.
